question: Should early source-message progress cleanup become a dedicated typed plugin lifecycle event, reuse ordinary `subagent_ended` semantics, or should this Discord-specific configuration surface be deferred?
rationale: The PR needs cleanup before ordinary completion delivery in some lifecycle paths, but choosing the permanent plugin API and seven-field operator contract is a maintainer-owned compatibility decision.

options.title: Add a typed progress event
options.body: Define a narrow typed lifecycle event with explicit retry and timing semantics, then keep the Discord implementation behind that plugin hook.

options.title: Reuse subagent ended
options.body: Use the existing `subagent_ended` event only if its deferred and persistent-session timing is intentionally acceptable for visible progress cleanup.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Do not add the configuration and lifecycle surface if its long-term compatibility cost outweighs the Discord feedback benefit.

recommendation.title: Add a typed progress event
recommendation.body: Define a narrow typed lifecycle event with explicit retry and timing semantics, then keep the Discord implementation behind that plugin hook.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history connects this owner most strongly to recent lifecycle hooks and the affected Discord/core boundary.
